about.title: About Malarvadi
about.clubsBody: In schools, children form Malarvadi Clubs guided by a Vidya Council — a democratic system where students take responsibility, plan activities together, and learn practical life skills through participation.
about.serviceTitle: Changathikkoru Veedu — a home for a friend
about.serviceBody: Malarvadi children collected money together and helped build 8 homes for families in need. It remains a living lesson in compassion and collective action.
about.heroLine: A movement of children, for a brighter tomorrow.
body: Malarvadi Balasangham is a collective that works towards the all-round growth and personality development of children. Beyond academic study, Malarvadi Balasangham focuses on nurturing creativity, talents, life skills, leadership, moral awareness and social commitment in children.

Malarvadi Balasangham designs a wide variety of programmes and activities that give children the opportunity to discover and develop their own talents and interests. It also provides the awareness and guidance children need on the matters they face today — the challenges of the digital world, screen addiction, complexities in personal relationships, lack of self-confidence and limitations in communication.

objectives.title: Objectives
objectives.intro: The main aim of Malarvadi Balasangham is to raise an upright generation with a sense of responsibility — one with moral awareness, ethical values, social commitment and leadership.
items: Nurtures the creative and intellectual abilities of children.
Develops the Life Skills needed to face the challenges of life with confidence and maturity.
Enables children to build healthy personal relationships and social interactions.
Creates awareness about the responsible use of digital technology and gives guidance on facing challenges including Screen Addiction.
Cultivates values such as morality, ethics, empathy and social responsibility in children.
Develops skills such as Leadership, Communication, Teamwork and Decision-Making in practical ways.
Creates opportunities for children to gain leadership experience by entrusting them with responsibilities such as Captain and Secretary at school and class level.
Organises awareness programmes including Parenting Classes to strengthen the role of parents.
Recognises the talents and interests of children and provides suitable platforms and opportunities to nurture them.

globalPresence.title: Our Global Presence
globalPresence.intro: Rooted in Kerala, Malarvadi Balasangham has active units that have spread its work to various parts of India and to regions such as the GCC countries, Europe and America.
body: Bringing together children and families in different parts of the world, Malarvadi continues its work with the aim of raising a generation that is value-conscious, capable, confident, socially committed and responsible.
